name: WinSpot: GUI Grounding Benchmark with Multimodal Large Language Models
notes: The annotation was reviewed against the ACL Anthology landing page and proceedings PDF. This short paper is separate from the WinClick preprint arxiv:2503.04730, which also introduces WinSpot and which the paper cites as prior work. Screenshots come from Bing image search over popular Microsoft Store apps, filtered with Phi-3-vision, labeled by an in-house icon detector and aligned with instructions by GPT-4o. The abstract counts 5,000 coordinate-instruction pairs, while the benchmark section describes over 5,000 annotated screenshots from 14 Windows applications.
summary: Introduces WinSpot, a Windows GUI grounding benchmark of 5,000 manually validated coordinate-instruction pairs, built by having multimodal LLMs label raw desktop screenshots without HTML or accessibility trees.
